panels.title: Institution-type compass
ascii_lines: MINISTRY -> policy administration and coordination
STATUTORY BOARD OR AUTHORITY -> Act-defined functions
RESEARCH INSTITUTE -> evidence training and advisory work
ENFORCEMENT BODY -> investigation or operational compliance role
TRIBUNAL -> adjudication within statutory jurisdiction

panels.title: MoEFCC role map
ascii_lines: UNION MINISTRY -> executive policy institution
LAW AND RULE ADMINISTRATION -> subject to statutory allocation
PROGRAMME AND INTERNATIONAL COORDINATION -> ministry function
SUBORDINATE OR AUTONOMOUS BODIES -> separate legal identities
RULE -> ministry is not every field regulator

panels.title: CPCB national rail
ascii_lines: ADVISE CENTRAL GOVERNMENT -> national policy input
COORDINATE STATE BOARDS -> inter-board function
TECHNICAL SUPPORT AND RESEARCH -> capacity and evidence
DATA GUIDELINES AND STANDARDS -> national outputs
IMPLEMENTATION -> relevant State Board or Committee remains distinct

panels.title: Standards-consent firewall
ascii_lines: CPCB STANDARD OR GUIDELINE -> national regulatory benchmark
SPCB OR PCC CONSENT -> project-specific permission context
INSPECTION AND ENFORCEMENT -> competent territorial authority
CENTRAL DIRECTION OR COORDINATION -> separate legal route
RULE -> one output cannot be substituted for another

panels.title: Biodiversity governance ladder
ascii_lines: NBA -> national biodiversity authority level
SBB -> state biodiversity governance level
BMC -> local-body biodiversity level
PBR -> local documentation instrument
ABS -> access and fair-benefit mechanism

panels.title: PBR-to-ABS sequence
ascii_lines: LOCAL KNOWLEDGE AND BIODIVERSITY -> documented carefully
PBR -> evidence and community knowledge record
ACCESS PROPOSAL -> separate legal assessment
BENEFIT ARRANGEMENT -> applicable ABS process
OUTCOME -> documentation alone grants no approval

panels.title: WII science pipeline
ascii_lines: RESEARCH QUESTION -> species habitat or management issue
FIELD AND ANALYTICAL STUDY -> evidence generated
TRAINING AND ADVISORY OUTPUT -> capacity and recommendations
COMPETENT AUTHORITY -> formal decision under law
RULE -> science informs but does not become regulation itself

panels.title: Wildlife body comparison
ascii_lines: WII -> research training and advisory science
NTCA -> tiger-conservation statutory authority
WCCB -> wildlife-crime coordination
STATE WILDLIFE MACHINERY -> territorial implementation
CPCB -> pollution control, not wildlife governance

panels.title: Adjudication boundary
ascii_lines: ADMINISTRATIVE DECISION -> ministry authority board or state body
MONITORING OR ENFORCEMENT -> competent executive institution
CHALLENGE OR DISPUTE -> applicable adjudicatory route
NGT -> tribunal within its statutory jurisdiction
RULE -> adjudication does not erase executive responsibility

panels.title: Legal-basis test
ascii_lines: CREATED DIRECTLY BY ACT -> statutory body
CONSTITUTED UNDER PARENT ACT -> notified authority
DELEGATED POWER -> scope follows delegation
AUTONOMOUS OR RESEARCH BODY -> institutional mandate
VERDICT -> cite the exact founding instrument

panels.title: Governance coordination chain
ascii_lines: POLICY -> sets direction
SCIENCE -> supplies evidence
STANDARD AND CONSENT -> regulate activity
MONITORING AND ENFORCEMENT -> test compliance
ADJUDICATION -> resolves qualifying disputes

panels.title: Institutions answer spine
ascii_lines: IDENTIFY -> ministry board authority institute force or tribunal
CITE -> founding Act notification delegation or mandate
MAP -> national state and local jurisdiction
SEPARATE -> standards consent science enforcement and adjudication
VERIFY -> current power direction staffing budget and reform evidence
